content.title: How to watch Dodgers vs. Rockies: TV channel and streaming options for April 18
content.text: Max Muncy leads the Los Angeles Dodgers into a matchup with the Colorado Rockies after homering twice in a 7-1 victory over the Rockies. It begins at 8:10 p.m. ET on Saturday. Emmet Sheehan (2-0, 6.60 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 15-4 this season and first in the NL West. Ryan Feltner (1-1, 7.30 ERA) is expected to start for the Rockies, who are 7-13 and fifth in the NL West.How to watch Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Colorado Rockies Venue: Coors Field Time: 8:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: Rockies.TV and SportsNet LA Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. In 85 plate appearances, Freddie Freeman is hitting .282/.341/.487 with a .828 OPS. He has hit three long balls, driven in 14 runs and scored nine times. In 50 plate appearances, he has recorded a .261 BA, .300 OBP and .630 SLG with a 6% walk rate and a 26% strikeout rate. He has been effective on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. He has hit five long balls (18th in MLB) and driven in eight runs with a strikeout rate of 40.5% and a walk rate of 8.1%. He has stolen one base on two attempts and has scored 13 runs.
